title: SUPER GIGA CM COX Speedrun (Leagues)
summary: Gnomonkey does a Challenge Mode Chambers of Xeric solo speedrun in Leagues, finishing at 19:54, which he believes is the fastest in Leagues. He explains the new CoX update shaved at least a minute off everyone's time, and gives a short explanation of how to correct the blob prayer cycle.

outline.text: Tekton opening, fastest Tekton ever at 1:24
Explaining two-ticking blobs and correcting the blob cycle
Current record discussion (25:45 mentioned) and Leagues vs main game
Update impact: at least a minute saved for everyone

claims.text: Gnomonkey finishes a Challenge Mode Chambers of Xeric solo run in Leagues at 19:54 and believes nobody in Leagues has a faster time.
Gnomonkey gets a 1:24 Tekton, which he says is his fastest Tekton ever.
The description says the new CoX update shaved massive time off Tekton, Thieving and Muttadile, which helped make a sub 20-minute run possible.
Gnomonkey says the new CoX update is insane and shaves at least a minute off everyone's time, guaranteed.
Gnomonkey mentions the current CM Chambers record as 25:45 when discussing times in chat.
The description says Gnomonkey ran out of cape swaps for world record attempts in the main game, so he moved to Leagues for fun; Newtype beat him by 20 seconds for the near-record time.
Gnomonkey says he had been attempting main game runs until he ran out of capes and then went to Leagues.
Standing on the Addy tile lets Gnomonkey automatically two-tick blobs, according to a chat answer.
There is one spawn where a blob sees you late, but it is two ticks before it sees you, so it is back on a two-tick cycle by default; that is the one behind the north pillar.

To correct the blob cycle, you check whether they attack: with two ticks on mage and two ticks on range, if you swap from mage to range and a blob attacks you, it is hitting on the second tick of your prayer rather than the first, so it is off-tick and you need to stall a tick.

topics.name: Leagues build for Chambers of Xeric

claims.text: Gnomonkey's relic setup for the run, per the description, is Production, Fairy, Banker's, Sorcerer's, Bloodthirsty, Farmer's, Berserker and Guardian.
The regions for the run were Khand, Desert and Kourend.
The description says the video is Gnomonkey's Leagues CM CoX speedrun with a Goth make-up cosplay for Hoshi as a thank-you for 100 subs.
Gnomonkey says in the description he cannot wait to keep pushing times in both Leagues and main game OSRS.
